name: MicroVMs
author: olafkfreund
description: NixOS MicroVMs for Omarchy, on the bar and on a key: disposable VMs from nixarchy vm and permanent machines from programs.nixarchy.services.microvm in one list. Start, stop, open the console, create, edit and delete from the keyboard. A permanent VM becomes one line in apps.nix that you review and then apply yourself. Optional AI assist fills the create form from a sentence.

barWidget.description: Your MicroVMs, running ones first, disposable and permanent side by side. Driven from the keyboard: enter or e opens the console, s starts or stops, r restarts, l follows the logs, m edits, x deletes, c creates, i describes one to the default agent, a applies queued changes, y copies the name, / filters, u refreshes, o shows the running log, and ? lists the lot inside the panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar glyph re-reads the VM lists. The panel refreshes every 3 seconds while it is open, regardless of this.

schema.label: Hide the bar icon when there are no VMs
schema.description: On removes the button from the bar until there is a VM to show.

schema.label: AI assist in the create form
schema.description: Off hides the describe field and the i key, even when the default agent supports it. The agent only ever proposes form values; it runs nothing.
